task: Hamster Champion refined plate and closed-helmet four-action H3 delivery
provider: MiniMax H3, explicitly requested by user
scope: Generate, rebuild, and integrate the approved idle, upright running, two-handed greatsword attack, and dying sprites; preserve the published main-branch unit values except for the user-authorized 1850ms attack interval

identity.description: Tan-and-white anthropomorphic hamster champion in refined late-medieval full plate, fully enclosed close helm, one long two-handed greatsword

eraSwapIsolation.rule: Each unit owns its runtime texture paths; no warrior texture key points at a mutable champion path

warriorRomanSheets.source: Git HEAD versions of the previously accepted Roman champion runtime sheets

icons.warrior: assets/ui/unit-icons/hamster-warrior.png stores the former Roman champion icon
icons.champion: assets/ui/unit-icons/hamster-champion.png is derived from approved plate idle frame 0

primaryMotionReference.note: Previously user-confirmed natural running loop; used for camera, body direction, stride axis, and cadence only

orientationCheck.camera: Slightly elevated, side-dominant three-quarter view facing screen-right with a limited amount of the front chest visible; qualitative comparison only
orientationCheck.bodyDirection: Helmet visor, chest plate, pelvis, knees and armored toes remain oriented broadly toward screen-right
orientationCheck.motionAxis: Alternating leg stride along screen X with natural shallow depth; no frontal walking toward the camera
orientationCheck.rootMotion: In-place action root; future entity movement controls world position
orientationCheck.weaponRule: Both gauntlets remain on the same two-handed greatsword; blade direction does not replace the body-direction check
orientationCheck.conclusion: Approved reference motion is suitable for H3 submission; raw H3 outputs must still pass 24-point direction and equipment-topology review

motionReferences.usage: Offline comparison only in v2; these videos are not uploaded to H3

generation.referenceMode: first-frame with identity-locked endpoint for loop actions

v1Rejected.reason: Ref2VA inherited the old motion subject's bare lower legs and feet, degraded plate topology, and long tail; only the closed helmet and single sword stayed stable
v1Rejected.decision: Do not submit legacy action videos as H3 references for v2

attackingV2Rejected.reason: The complete sword leaves the top edge during the wind-up and peak attack around frames 16-27, with another cropped high arc near frame 64
attackingV2Rejected.decision: Regenerate v3 from a 72 percent scale attack reference with broader action margins

attackingV3Rejected.reason: The smaller subject improved margins but H3 still chose an overhead wind-up and cropped the sword tip around frames 16-21
attackingV3Rejected.decision: Regenerate v4 from a purpose-authored low backswing keyframe and keep the slash below helmet height

dyingV2Rejected.reason: The collapse and final still pose were usable, but the hidden short tail stretched into a long pointed rat tail from about frame 59 onward
dyingV2Rejected.decision: Regenerate v3 from a no-visible-tail guard reference

runningV2Rejected.reason: User rejected the posture: the torso leans and folds too far forward, reading as a hunched crouch-sprint rather than an upright armored run
runningV2Rejected.decision: Regenerate v3 from a purpose-authored upright keyframe with the helmet centered above the pelvis and the chest lifted throughout

v2References.background: uniform chroma blue #2060E0 composited with BiRefNet for the approved idle/run references and border-connected white matte for the approved attack/death references

actions.intendedMode: loop with first and last frame locked to the same plate-armored identity reference
actions.review: Closed helmet, complete leg and foot plate, one connected greatsword, fixed root, and stable right-facing identity across all 24 sampled frames

actions.intendedMode: loop from an identity-locked short-legged mid-stride keyframe
actions.review: Rejected after user review because the generated cycle reads as a hunched crouch-sprint

actions.intendedMode: seamless upright in-place screen-right run with the chest lifted and helmet centered above the pelvis
actions.review: Passed the 24-point and enlarged 8-point offline review: chest remains lifted, helmet stays above the pelvis, no hunched crouch-sprint returns during support-leg changes, and the closed helmet, full plate, both gauntlets, short tail, and single complete greatsword stay stable

actions.intendedMode: v4 single low horizontal two-handed slash with no overhead wind-up
actions.review: One low two-handed slash and recovery; the full sword stays inside the frame, with connected motion-blurred blade and stable plate identity

actions.intendedMode: v3 one-way collapse from a 72 percent scale no-visible-tail guard reference, ending in a still final pose
actions.review: Continuous irreversible collapse, stable prone ending, full sword in frame, complete plate, and only a short tail segment visible after the fall

runtimeTimingContract.sourceSampling: native H3 f0,f3,...,f120; 41 real source poses
runtimeTimingContract.interpolationMode: native-source fallback; no synthetic RIFE attack frames
runtimeTimingContract.repairReason: RIFE changed the connected sword/arms and its alpha-bottom alignment mistook the low blade tip for a foot, shifting synthetic middle frames by 8/18/2 px
runtimeTimingContract.rootStability: locked 544x288 integrated layout, fixed source anchor 541/511, footY 228, stable armored-body bottom y227..229
runtimeTimingContract.blueEdgeCleanup: Neutralize blue/cyan RGB only inside the source 4px and placed 2px silhouette bands at the same luminance; preserve alpha exactly; remaining detected blue-edge spill is zero across all 41 frames
runtimeTimingContract.timingShape: frames 0-7 total 40ms, frames 8-23 total 160ms, damage frame 25 enters at 200ms, frames 24-40 recover over 300ms
runtimeTimingContract.attackIntervalSemantics: start of one attack to start of the next attack
runtimeTimingContract.implementationRule: The attack animation, damage contact, sound start, recovery, and AI animation lock use the existing unified friendly-attack clock
runtimeTimingContract.balanceRule: User explicitly authorized attackInterval=1850ms; preserve damage and every other unit value

runningTimingContract.implementationRule: Use one complete same-leg native H3 cycle [f41,f61), exclude the duplicate endpoint, interpolate each adjacent frame and the f60-to-f41 seam once, and preserve the source 24 fps wall-clock motion at 48 fps after 2x RIFE
runningTimingContract.balanceRule: Preserve the entity movement speed and all other unit values

repositoryCleanup.policy: Retain approved mothers, accepted H3 source videos, prompts/provider JSON, final references, pre-RIFE source sheets, exact runtime previews, reports and rebuild scripts; remove rejected video binaries, extracted-frame caches, candidate RIFE sheets and duplicate or superseded previews

runtimeIntegration.pipeline: approved H3 video -> BiRefNet-general -> fixed action transform and effective-body normalization -> RIFE v4.6 2x by default, with native H3 source-frame fallback when RIFE changes equipment topology -> per-action compact sheet

idle.blueEdgeCleanup: source 4px + placed 2px same-luminance RGB neutralization; alpha unchanged; source keys remaining 0

walk.blueEdgeCleanup: source full-chroma despill + 4px edge and placed 2px same-luminance RGB neutralization; alpha unchanged; source keys remaining 0

attack.blueEdgeCleanup: source 4px + placed 2px RGB-only neutralization; alpha unchanged; remaining 0

dying.blueEdgeCleanup: source 4px + placed 2px same-luminance RGB neutralization; alpha unchanged; source keys remaining 0

runtimeIntegration.budgetReason: Retain the approved source-scale plate and greatsword silhouette with per-action tight cells; no global budget increase and no duplicate warrior texture keys

attackGifContract.reason: 25 temporally sampled preview frames keep every GIF delay at 20ms, avoiding Chromium's 10ms-to-100ms clamp

runtimeIntegration.balanceChangeSummary: Change only attackInterval from the published 2300ms baseline to the user-authorized 1850ms start-to-start interval; preserve every other published gameplay value

postGenerationGate.result: Running v03 remains the accepted native same-leg [f41,f61) loop. Attack v04 uses 41 native H3 f0..f120 step-3 frames on the locked runtime layout. All four runtime actions apply narrow-band same-luminance blue-edge cleanup with alpha unchanged. The unified attack animation is 500ms with a non-uniform clock, damage contact is frame 25 at 200ms, there is no extra tail hold, and the user-authorized attack interval is 1850ms start-to-start; every other published gameplay value remains unchanged.
required: Inspect each raw 24-point contact sheet before background removal or RIFE
Confirm right-facing chest and pelvis direction across the full running gait
Confirm closed helmet, plate topology, two hands and one connected greatsword remain stable
Reject direction drift, open visor, weapon duplication, limb topology errors, camera zoom, or frame cropping
notRun: game, browser, build, or EXE testing
